blocks.text: Myanmar’s military-backed government on Monday released rare photos of the country’s detained pro-democracy leader Aung San Suu Kyi, who is under house arrest, receiving letters and books from Britain’s King Charles. Observers believe the move is meant to signal that the treatment of the 81-year-old Nobel Peace Prize laureate has improved as the pro-military government seeks to gain legitimacy and end its international isolation following the 2021 coup that toppled her democratically elected government.
